content.short: Pinata is a leading media management company for builders and creators in Web3.
content.description: Pinata sits at the center of media storage and data sharing across Web3, giving creators a reliable way to store and share files without sacrificing size or quality. It provides fast, secure IPFS uploads and practical features to gate content, generate short links, and preview posts. Backed by investors including OpenSea, Yuga Labs, and Polygon, Pinata supports scalable decentralized media workflows and helps manage assets across networks with strong performance and accessibility.
